label: Connect distinct local goods to a common source without conflating their grounds
summary: At 561ba7d5 developed two common-ground routes in docs/notes/transcendental-foundation-routes.md: identity when both candidates satisfy ActualRoot in the same profile and relation, and a common causal source of plural local perfections. Reused the unique necessary root, actual common-root coverage and restricted causal-perfection transfer results; uniqueness alone does not supply coverage or identify a normative standard with a concretum. Consulted ST I q.6 a.4 corpus [28491] for the distinction between first source and recipients' formal goodness, without new formal attribution. Composed the organism, factual-guidance, basing and agency investigations while retaining efficient source, constitutive standard and normative authority as distinct relations. Positive provisional assessment favors the two-level explanatory compatibility; categorical authority and the actual normative-to-root mapping remain open. The same note records the scoped five-connection handoff and next discriminating cases. No new theorem, graph edge or root-premise discharge.
